title: Mode State Transition Diagram
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Explain the mode state machine's states and transitions by clicking each mode and each transition arrow to interpret what button action triggers it, what the global state variable's value becomes, and what the face does in that mode.
